changes.why: every render's 1x captures pixel-identical to c05-control's (X48)

charter: docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-03-w45-span-selective-texture.md (Design "The moves", "The landing rule"; Decision Logs 2, 3 and 4; X56)

references.why: every regression row and T1's change read the published c05 generation by hash (X52)

startingPoints.rule: both paths run stage 1 then stage 2 from their own starting point; both are recorded; the landed point is the better of the two final points by the selection metric on the one gate population (X56), a tie going to the fewer moved leaves

fitCells: the gate partition of the light 0.25 profiles (every T1 cell less the canonical holdout and the referees), 2x WebGPU; the planner's pre-gate probe whitelist with the canonical calibration, validation and recorded sets; the loader refuses a referee or holdout row; every fit render passes --alpha, so a fit row equals a stage row (W44 G1's tracker note)
searchProcedure: within a stage (a `moves` entry), each leaf's grid is swept in the order listed, the others held at their current values, keeping the grid point with the smallest stage objective; at most two passes; a full factorial sweep of a stage's grids is permitted and is not required. The stage objective is W44's selection metric restricted to the stage's cells (cuts/rule.py stage_objective); candidates of one content render once (their resolved digests compared, W44 G1's tracker note)

moves.cells: 2x WebGPU rest, spans mid and thick (96-160), fit cells, F u T u C u P (T read on its bands; the objective reads F u C u P)

sizeHeavySecondSigma.inert: proven by the ladders: every rung's 1x captures pixel-identical to c05-control's (ladders/results.json, X48)

moves.name: the thin start and the receded overrides

sizeHeavySecondShare.unit: signed fraction, a difference over the active document

receded.prediction: the receded share lands at the active share as in W44, and the receded farDelta at the active's

interactions: after the two stages the full T1 map is re-read at each path's final point; a stage UNDID the other when a cell of the other stage's `cells` that it left within is a miss at the final point; the undoing stage is refitted once on the union of the two stages' cells
notCandidates: sizeScatterHeavyShareThick2x (struck by Decision Log 2: not in the document's leaf set, saturated at 96)
sizeScatterScaleGain (one leaf for both scales; X48)

selectionRule.withinAStage: the stage's point with a passing within clause and the smallest stage objective lands the stage
selectionRule.atTheFinalPoint: between the two paths' final points, the smaller selection metric lands: the median |log(web / native)| over F u C u P, 2x WebGPU light, gate partition (t1.selection_metric)
selectionRule.tie: two metrics within the selection tie of each other (the median over the same cells of log(1 + bar / native), t1.selection_tie; on a stage's cells rule.stage_tie) tie, and the tie goes to the fewer moved leaves

landingRule.partition: unchanged if |k - c| <= bar; else toward if g <= 0; else away with g. No crossing state
landingRule.bands: F, C, P on T1; T on T1-fine for fidelity, change and its aggregate, T1-low for away only
landingRule.aggregate: per stratum x pose, A = median |log((k + eps)/(n + eps))|, eps one code; tau = median log(1 + bar/(n + eps)); gated at three cells or more, reported otherwise
landingRule.budget: one over all 116 cells per profile: at most three cells away with g > B, none with g > 3B, each named; the gate's cells counted before the exposure and the exposed cells added at it
landingRule.fullClose: every F cell within; every gated group's A at most c05's A + tau; the budget; every other adopted row passing or named; the twelve referees within at the exposure
landingRule.improvement: the F aggregate (both poses pooled) at most half of c05's; every gated group's A at most c05's A + tau; the budget; every referee within or an unchanged miss; every other adopted row passing or named
landingRule.exposure: an exposed cell that takes the count past three, or any cell past 3B at the exposure, is a holdout miss, ruled by the parent
landingRule.unmeasured: a member of the scope with no reading makes the verdict UNMEASURED, never a landing
landingRule.otherwise: the wave closes at the finding

candidateIdentity: a candidate's dark endpoints are patch- and digest-identical to c05's dark documents; its light endpoints are c05's on every leaf but the declared 2x leaves of the stages (and, in the receded light document, the second tap's share and the operator's key as differences); a candidate carries the glass0.250 key, so the identity is patch-and-digest
permittedChanges: strike: remove a leaf its ladder read flat, citing the ladder by id
narrow: replace a grid by a non-empty subset of itself inside its ladder's non-flat range, citing the ladder
inert: replace the 1x width's PENDING inert setting with the ladder evidence (X48 at every rung); the value stays 0
